wrong.why: Verse 25 makes Rephah and Resheph both sons of Ephraim ('Rephah was his son, also Resheph'), so Resheph is not Rephah's son.
'his sons were Ulam and Rakem' refers to Peresh, the son just named, whose brother is Sheresh; the verse does not make Sheresh their father.
Verse 37 lists Shilshah among Zophah's sons alongside Beera, so he is Beera's brother, not his descendant.
The verse makes Hushim a son of Aher, and Ehi is not named there; the row needs an unstated reading of Aher as Ehi.

missing.why: Verse 6 lists Jediael among the sons of Benjamin.
After 'Tahath his son' (7:20) the verse gives 'Zabad his son', so Zabad is the son of the second Tahath.
Verse 26 opens 'Laadan his son' directly after Tahan in verse 25.
Verse 27 opens 'Non his son' directly after Elishama in verse 26.

note: The 7:20-27 'his son' chain (Tahath, Tahan, Elishama) is what the missing rows fill in. Owner rows amal and zophah son-of hotham (7:35 names Helem as father) and hanniel-2 son-of jephunneh-2 (7:39 names Ulla) look wrong against the text; they rest on variant identifications and are left alone.
